title: UnpredictaBench：评估大语言模型分布随机性的基准
summary: UnpredictaBench是一个评估LLM捕捉真实分布能力的基准，包含448个问题，使用KS@N指标衡量模型输出与目标分布的匹配程度。测试发现模型在分布采样上表现差异大，最高仅40%以上，表明该能力仍有显著提升空间。
summary_en: UnpredictaBench is a benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to capture true underlying distributions, with 448 problems and KS@N metric. Results show large spread in distributional capabilities, with no model exceeding 40% at KS@100, indicating significant headroom.
